d:
Dilli ki jamiya milliya islamiya bite dinon yahan hue student protest ke chalte charcha men rahi. yunivarsiti men chhatr sangh chunav karvae jane ki mang ko lekar kaee students ne protest kiya. aakhirkar yunivarsiti prashasan ne students ki mangon par sahamti jataee. janie ki jamiya milliya islamiya ka itihas kya hai aur mahatma gandhi ki ismen kya bhumika thi?
Vidiyoh navin negi aur aamra aamir
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
